#+TITLE: Numeric Calc comparisons and conditions

Comparisons have the same precedence below arithmetic and return integer booleans.

| less | greater | less equal | greater equal | equal | unequal | equal alias |
|------+---------+------------+---------------+-------+---------+-------------|
| 0    | 0       | 0          | 0             | 0     | 0       | 0           |
#+TBLFM: @2$1=2<3::@2$2=2>3::@2$3=3<=3::@2$4=3>=4::@2$5=3==3.0::@2$6=3!=4::@2$7=3=3

| arithmetic | power | negative | fraction | exact integer | tiny | huge |
|------------+-------+----------+----------+---------------+------+------|
| 0          | 0     | 0        | 0        | 0             | 0    | 0    |
#+TBLFM: @2$1=1+2<2*2::@2$2=-2^2<0::@2$3=-3<-2::@2$4=1/3<0.34;F::@2$5=9007199254740993>9007199254740992::@2$6=1e-400>0::@2$7=1e309>1e308

Comparisons use Calc's internal precision, independently of display precision.

| display | internal | higher precision |
|---------+----------+------------------|
| 0       | 0        | 0                |
#+TBLFM: @2$1=1.0001>1;n3::@2$2=1.0000000000001>1::@2$3=1.0000000000001>1;p20

| ascending | descending | inclusive | outside | grouped | equals | distinct | repeated |
|-----------+------------+-----------+---------+---------+--------+----------+----------|
| 0         | 0          | 0         | 0       | 0       | 0      | 0        | 0        |
#+TBLFM: @2$1=1<2<3::@2$2=3>2>1::@2$3=1<=1<=2::@2$4=3<2<1::@2$5=(3>2)>1::@2$6=2==2.0==2::@2$7=1!=2!=3::@2$8=1!=2!=1

| condition | yes | no | negative | float zero | nested | format |
|-----------+-----+----+----------+------------+--------+--------|
| 3         | 0   | 0  | 0        | 0          | 0      | 0      |
#+TBLFM: @2$2=if($1>2,10,20)::@2$3=if($1<2,10,20)::@2$4=if(-2,10,20)::@2$5=if(0.0,10,20)::@2$6=if($1>2,if($1==3,30,40),50)::@2$7=if($1>=3,25/2,0);%.2f
